name: ghoast
description: GHOAST — privacy-first Instagram relationship intelligence. Reads your official Instagram data export entirely on your device. No login, no password, no upload.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/web && npm run build --workspace=apps/extension
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=apps/web && npm run test --workspace=apps/extension
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --workspace=apps/web && npm run test:unit --workspace=apps/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/extension
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run build
